note: Universe of Irish public bodies: the CSO Register of Public Sector Bodies 2024 (final, released 2025-10-20), central government Tables 3.1-3.19 plus local authorities (Table 4.1). Sponsor = the department table the body sits in, under the department names the 2024 register uses (the children department was renamed in 2025; see ie-bodies.json). The Register classifies bodies as general government for national accounts, so it is NOT a complete list of bodies with a children function: voluntary organisations are outside it except those classified into government (Table 3.19), and coordinating structures hosted by another body (e.g. county committees) are not rows in it. Commercial corporations are listed here but screened out by name and remit without reading their documents.
